title: Directorate for Geosciences (GEO)
summary: The Directorate Profiles from the National Center for Science and Engineering Statistics within the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) provide visualizations on research doctorate recipients from U.S. institutions, by NSF directorate. This profile presents data for doctorates in geosciences, using the 2025 Survey of Earned Doctorates and the 2023 Survey of Doctorate Recipients.
